subject: Remove labels for selected tips (or all tips at one nodes)

messages.author: eeb86d2e51c729c1
messages.subject: Remove labels for selected tips (or all tips at one nodes)
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to delete not to show the labels for certain taxa at the tip. From the manual, I know you can add labels to specific tips or nodes by doing something like

```
geom_text(aes(label=label),
            data=td_filter(isTip & node==165),
            hjust=0)
```

But, instead of adding, I am wondering whether there are ways to delete tip labels or not to show tip labels?

Thank you
